method: Original summaries verified against publisher, author, Folger and exact-edition catalogue evidence. ISBN, title, author and language guard every text. Collections, pen names and US/UK title variants are explicit. No generic withdrawn-provider fallback is enabled.

entries.title: Holiday in death
entries.author: Nora Roberts
entries.text:
In this In Death novel, Nora Roberts writes as J.D. Robb. New York detective Eve Dallas investigates a series of Christmas-season killings whose victims are connected to Personally Yours, an exclusive dating service. A murderer dressed as Santa turns the search for companionship into a threat, using a pattern inspired by the Twelve Days of Christmas.

Eve follows that pattern into a circle of clients looking for love, where personal hopes and carefully managed appearances complicate her search for the killer.
entries.identityNotes: Exact ISIS edition credits J.D. Robb, the pen name of catalogue author Nora Roberts. This is the In Death novel, not the separate Midnight in Death novella.

entries.title: Twelfth Night
entries.author: William Shakespeare
entries.text:
Separated from her twin brother Sebastian in a shipwreck, Viola enters Duke Orsino's household disguised as a young man. Orsino sends her to court Olivia on his behalf, but Olivia becomes interested in the messenger instead. Viola's own feelings make the arrangement still more difficult.

Shakespeare's comedy follows this tangle of mistaken identities and unreturned affection alongside the schemes within Olivia's household. Disguise lets characters cross social boundaries, while Sebastian's arrival threatens to overturn what everyone thinks they know.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Washington Square Press ISBN is a New Folger Library Shakespeare edition. Synopsis concerns the play; 1623 is first printing, not composition or performance.

entries.title: The Moving Finger
entries.author: Agatha Christie
entries.text:
Jerry Burton arrives in an English village to recover from an accident, hoping for a quiet stay. Instead, anonymous letters begin spreading accusations through the community, and neighbours who once trusted one another grow suspicious. Jerry observes the damage as private anxieties become public gossip.

Miss Marple enters the investigation later, bringing her understanding of everyday behaviour to a case shaped by appearances and assumptions. The novel follows the letters' unsettling effects through Jerry's perspective, making the village's ordinary relationships central to its mystery.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Tandem Library edition of the novel. Miss Marple enters late; do not treat Jerry Burton as Marple or claim a specific UK/US text length.

entries.title: Shakespeare
entries.author: William Shakespeare
entries.text:
Edited by G. B. Harrison, this edition of Shakespeare: The Complete Works brings the plays and poetry together in a single collection. Its contents range from the history plays and comedies to Hamlet, King Lear and Macbeth, followed by poems including Venus and Adonis, The Rape of Lucrece and the sonnets.

An introductory section considers Shakespeare's life, England, theatre and the study of his texts. Additional material addresses the world behind the writing, giving readers context for exploring several kinds of work within the same volume.
entries.identityNotes: Exact ISBN 9780155805309 has subtitle The Complete Works and editor G. B. Harrison. Contents include plays, poems, sonnets, introduction and appendices. It is not a biography. The inherited 1794 work date is not verified for this collection; no guessed printing year is supplied.

entries.title: Remembered Death
entries.author: Agatha Christie
entries.text:
Remembered Death is the American title of Sparkling Cyanide. A year after Rosemary Barton died from poisoning during a restaurant dinner, the surviving guests return to the same table. An empty place marks her absence, while memories of her life expose how differently the people around her understood her.

Colonel Race becomes involved in a mystery built around that earlier evening and its consequences. The repeated gathering brings old attachments, resentments and secrets back into focus as the circumstances of Rosemary's death are examined.
entries.identityNotes: Remembered Death is the US title of Sparkling Cyanide, a Colonel Race novel; not the Poirot short story Yellow Iris.

entries.title: Murder at Hazelmoor
entries.author: Agatha Christie
entries.text:
Published in Britain as The Sittaford Mystery, Murder at Hazelmoor begins with a gathering at an isolated house on Dartmoor. A seance produces an alarming message claiming that Captain Trevelyan has been murdered. His home is miles away, and heavy snow makes checking the claim a difficult journey on foot.

The message turns an evening's entertainment into a mystery about what the participants know and how they could know it. The wintry setting and apparent supernatural warning frame Christie's investigation of a very human crime.
entries.identityNotes: US title of The Sittaford Mystery. Do not add Miss Marple from the television adaptation to the novel.

entries.title: Sleeping Murder
entries.author: Agatha Christie
entries.text:
Gwenda's new seaside home begins to feel disturbingly familiar. As she changes the house, details of its past surface, and a sudden fear on the staircase leaves her struggling to explain her reactions. What should be a fresh start becomes an unsettling encounter with something she cannot comfortably remember.

She turns to Miss Marple for help. Together they investigate a crime committed many years earlier, following the traces that remain beneath an apparently ordinary domestic setting. The mystery centres on memory and the danger of reopening a concealed past.
entries.identityNotes: Bantam edition of Miss Marple's Last Case. First published 1976; do not confuse disputed wartime composition dates with publication.

entries.title: One Night With His Wife
entries.author: Lynne Graham
entries.text:
Luc and Star separated soon after a hurried marriage, but they never divorced. When Luc finds her eighteen months later, he suspects that she is involved in fraud. Discovering that she now has twins adds another layer of mistrust to their reunion.

Luc proposes an intimate bargain in exchange for dropping the charge, expecting their encounter to be temporary. Instead, renewed attraction forces the estranged couple to confront the unfinished business of their marriage and the assumptions that have kept them apart.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Thorndike edition. Main characters Luc and Star; surname spelling varies within the author's page, so omit surname.

entries.title: The Awakening
entries.author: Nora Roberts
entries.text:
Breen Kelly feels trapped by debt and an unhappy teaching job until she discovers an investment account her mother has kept secret. The money came from her absent father, and it gives her the chance to travel to Ireland in search of answers.

There, a portal leads her toward Talamh, a world of magic where Keegan carries the responsibility of protecting his people. The first Dragon Heart Legacy novel follows Breen as she begins to understand her origins and the unfamiliar abilities and dangers connected to them.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Thorndike ISBN is Nora Roberts's 2020 Dragon Heart Legacy novel, not another author's book of the same title. Publisher evidence supplies the story, not selected edition pagination.

entries.title: Naive Bride, Defiant Wife
entries.author: Lynne Graham
entries.text:
Alejandro has never accepted the collapse of his marriage to Jemima. Convinced that she betrayed him, he hires a detective to find her. The report places her in England with a young son, deepening his resentment and prompting him to seek a confrontation.

Jemima remains his wife, and their reunion forces the couple back into the conflict they left unresolved. Also published as Jemima's Secret, this opening story in Secretly Pregnant, Conveniently Wed turns on wounded trust, family pressures and the assumptions behind Alejandro's desire for revenge.
entries.identityNotes: UK title also published as Jemima's Secret. Attribute allegations to Alejandro, not as established facts about Jemima. First Secretly Pregnant, Conveniently Wed book.

entries.title: The MacGregor Grooms
entries.author: Nora Roberts
entries.text:
Daniel MacGregor has already helped steer his granddaughters toward marriage, and now he has plans for his grandsons. D.C., Duncan and Ian are busy pursuing their own ambitions, but their grandfather believes he understands the partners they need better than they do.

This collection follows the three men through interconnected romances as Daniel's matchmaking challenges their determination to remain single. His confidence in lasting love brings family expectations into collision with independent lives, while each grandson faces a different route toward commitment.
entries.identityNotes: Exact Silhouette edition is the trio of interconnected stories about three grandsons; not The MacGregor Brides.
